description: 8 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings of creating or fixing a DTO in a Laravel project: attribute mapping, SimpleDto/LiteDto, model linkage, DTO from request data. Should-not-trigger covers neighbours: form-request validation, Eloquent queries, API resources, migrations, and an unrelated frontend task.

queries.q: create a DTO for the Order model in this Laravel app
erstelle ein DTO für die Kunden-Tabelle
map these snake_case DB columns onto a DTO with attributes
my #[Map] attributes on the DTO are ignored, why?
should this DTO extend SimpleDto or LiteDto?
replace this array<string, mixed> parameter with a DTO
link the DTO to its Eloquent model
DTO aus den Request-Daten bauen und an den Service geben
add validation rules to this form request
optimise this Eloquent query with eager loading
shape this JSON response with an API resource
write a migration that adds a column
